title: Security Deposit on a New Service Agreement: Assessment
content:
A new service agreement that is still pending start and was opened without a waiver basis is assessed a new-service Security Deposit of the kind its customer class and rate schedule call for, within the assessment window after its start date, and the deposit required is worked out on the assessment date.

**Conditions on the customer's other deposits.**

- The deposit required on a new agreement is not fixed until every other deposit of the customer that stands assessed shows its first installment received.
- The deposit required on a new agreement is fixed only after any deposit of the customer whose satisfactory payment review has been passed on its refund review date stands refunded.

| The customer's other deposit, as its record stands | Does it hold up fixing the new agreement's deposit? |
|---|---|
| Assessed, with its first installment shown as received | No |
| Assessed, with no first installment received | Yes |
| Review passed on its refund review date, still standing held | Yes |
| Review passed on its refund review date, standing refunded | No |

**Triggers that stay with their own agreement.** A disconnection, a late payment count or an unauthorized-use finding never triggers a deposit on a new agreement opened after it; the deposit it triggers is assessed on the agreement that carries it, within the assessment window after the disconnection date, after the posting date of the late payment charge that reached the trigger count, or after the date of the field investigation that confirmed the unauthorized use.

**Installments.** The number of installments of a deposit on a new agreement is not set at assessment; it is recorded with the deposit's opening installment.

## Recording the assessment: `assess_new_service_deposit_5e8da269`

**Capability.** The tool assesses a cash Security Deposit on a newly opened service agreement of a customer. It creates a new deposit in assessed status on the stated agreement, dated today, for the reason of new service, to be met in cash, with the stated kind, average monthly bill, required amount and first installment due date; nothing has been received on it yet, and its number of installments is left at zero until an installment is paid. The deposit then shows in the customer's security deposits with its new reference number.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `customer_id`: the customer reference number of the agreement's customer of record, as returned by the customer profile lookup.
- `service_account_id`: the service account number of the newly opened agreement the deposit secures, as returned by the service-agreement lookup for the customer.
- `variant_name`: the deposit kind, one of "Residential New Service Deposit" (a residential agreement on Schedules RS, RT or REV opened without a waiver basis), "Residential Reestablishment Deposit" (a residential agreement disconnected for nonpayment or with a late payment history), "Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit" (a residential agreement with confirmed meter tampering or diversion), "Small Commercial Service Deposit" (a business agreement on Schedules GS or GST), "Medium Commercial Service Deposit" (a business agreement on Schedule GD) or "Large Power Service Deposit" (a business agreement on Schedule LP).
- `average_monthly_bill`: the average monthly bill the requirement rests on, in USD with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent.
- `required_amount`: the deposit amount required, in USD with 2 decimal places, a whole-dollar amount written with .00 cents.
- `first_installment_due_date`: the date the first (or only) installment is due, written YYYY-MM-DD as a calendar date with no time of day.

**Return.** A one-line text receipt naming the new deposit reference number, the agreement, the deposit kind, the required amount and average monthly bill in USD with 2 decimal places, the status (assessed) and the first installment due date; the deposit reference number in the receipt confirms the deposit was assessed.
